// diagnostic

L2901

This `#Test` block has no assertions.

What

This `#Test` block has no assertions.

Why

A test with no `assert`, `assert_eq`, or `expect(…).snapshot()` call cannot find bugs — it always passes.

Fix

add at least one assertion, or remove the test if it only exercises compilation.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L2901: tests/ui_lint/test_without_assertion.warn.
